formulas.name: Applicant_Requests_Oral_Hearing_TA_DefaultText
formulas.expression: '[[Thank you for your correspondence dated [[insert date]], in which you gave your consent to the application being considered by way of the written representation procedure. Please note that we received a response from the applicant who did not give their consent and requested an oral hearing.]]'

formulas.name: formula_CurrentDate
formulas.expression: TEXT( DAY(TODAY()) ) & CASE( MOD(DAY(TODAY()), 10), 1, IF(DAY(TODAY()) = 11, "th", "st"), 2, IF(DAY(TODAY()) = 12, "th", "nd"), 3, IF(DAY(TODAY()) = 13, "th", "rd"), "th" ) & " " & CASE( MONTH(TODAY()), 1, "January", 2, "February", 3, "March", 4, "April", 5, "May", 6, "June", 7, "July", 8, "August", 9, "September", 10, "October", 11, "November", 12, "December", "" ) & " " & TEXT(YEAR(TODAY()))

formulas.name: No_Response_Received_Applicant_Requests_Oral_Hearing_TA_DefaultText
formulas.expression: '[[We refer to our previous letter dated [[CTWR letter date]], in which we sought your consent for the application to be considered by way of the written representation procedure. It is noted that we did not receive a response from you by the deadline. Please note that we received a response from the applicant who did not give their consent and requested an oral hearing.]]'
